title: Fused H1 matched flag-zero root
objective: Generate and validate a single timed native H1 root from prepared input through adapted eager relations, HNF/compact state, and exactly one p192 getfu PRECI publication without host conversion or stronger retry work

oracles: isolated GMP p192 PRECI root state

runs.result: pass; fixed 4 GiB/600 s thin-addon correctness gate; peak aggregate RSS 1794924 KiB
pass; seven qualified alternating pairs; Outcome C threshold not met

handoff.summary: Qualified the fully fused same-work H1 flag-zero boundary over seven alternating pairs; all evidence agrees, but the 2.426 s Sage.js median versus 15.029 ms PARI median fails Outcome C.
risks: The fused native graph remains about 161x slower and uses about 1.69 GiB peak RSS despite eliminating host conversion and the stronger exact suffix.
next_steps: Profile the authenticated fused generated graph to localize exact-buffer, private ABI/status, and storage-reuse costs without changing the matched boundary.
